lines: After AI 410, this is what you can build with AI.
This is a real app, running live: a support assistant for an outdoor gear store.
Ask about returns, and it answers from the store's own policy documents, not from guesswork.
Ask for a total, and it decides to call its calculator tool, instead of doing the math in its head.
And every step it takes can be traced.
Ask about something the documents don't cover, and it says it doesn't know.

lines.text: Then add a new rental sheet.

lines: A background worker reads it, and seconds later, the assistant can answer.

lines.text: The same app runs on a phone, through a mobile client you build too.

lines: You build each piece in AI 410, across four hands-on units.
Then your team builds an app of its own.
Part of the BS in AI at City University of Seattle.
See the course at the link on screen.
